label.text: Read-only diagram. Keep the bpmn.io watermark visible.

render-mode.text:
<textarea id="wf-monitor-xml" style="display:none">${monitorBpmnXml!}</textarea>
<textarea id="wf-monitor-activities" style="display:none">${currentActivitiesJson!'[]'}</textarea>
<textarea id="wf-monitor-completed" style="display:none">${completedActivitiesJson!'[]'}</textarea>
<textarea id="wf-monitor-flows" style="display:none">${completedFlowsJson!'[]'}</textarea>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset/get?file=diagram-js.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset/get?file=bpmn-js.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset/get?file=bpmn.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset/get?file=bpmn-font-fix.css&v=7"/>
<script src="/apps/collie-flowable/Asset/get?file=bpmn-navigated-viewer.production.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function initMonitor() {
  function isModelerCtor(Ctor) {
    return !!(Ctor && Ctor.prototype && typeof Ctor.prototype.createDiagram === 'function');
  }
  function viewerCtor() {
    if (window.BpmnNavigatedViewer && !isModelerCtor(window.BpmnNavigatedViewer)) return window.BpmnNavigatedViewer;
    if (window.BpmnJS && !isModelerCtor(window.BpmnJS)) {
      window.BpmnNavigatedViewer = window.BpmnJS;
      return window.BpmnNavigatedViewer;
    }
    return null;
  }
  var Ctor = viewerCtor();
  if (!Ctor) {
    if (!window._wfViewerLoading) {
      window._wfViewerLoading = true;
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = '/apps/collie-flowable/Asset/get?file=bpmn-navigated-viewer.production.min.js&_wfViewer=1';
      s.onload = function () {
        window.BpmnNavigatedViewer = window.BpmnJS;
        window._wfViewerLoading = false;
        initMonitor();
      };
      s.onerror = function () { window._wfViewerLoading = false; };
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    } else {
      setTimeout(initMonitor, 80);
    }
    return;
  }
  var el = document.getElementById('wf-monitor-canvas');
  if (!el || el.getAttribute('data-wf-ready') === '1') return;
  var xmlEl = document.getElementById('wf-monitor-xml');
  if (!xmlEl) { setTimeout(initMonitor, 80); return; }
  var xml = (xmlEl.value || '').trim();
  if (!xml) return;
  el.setAttribute('data-wf-ready', '1');
  function parseList(id) {
    try { return JSON.parse((document.getElementById(id) || {}).value || '[]'); } catch (e) { return []; }
  }
  var activities = parseList('wf-monitor-activities');
  var completed = parseList('wf-monitor-completed');
  var flows = parseList('wf-monitor-flows');
  var viewer = new Ctor({ container: el });
  var canvasApi = null;
  function fitCanvas() {
    try { (canvasApi || viewer.get('canvas')).resized(); } catch (ignored) {}
  }
  var ro = null;
  function cleanup() {
    if (ro) { try { ro.disconnect(); } catch (ignored) {} ro = null; }
    window.removeEventListener('resize', fitCanvas);
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    ro = new ResizeObserver(function () { fitCanvas(); });
    ro.observe(el);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fitCanvas);
  var goneWatch = new MutationObserver(function () {
    if (!el.isConnected) { cleanup(); goneWatch.disconnect(); }
  });
  goneWatch.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  viewer.importXML(xml).then(function () {
    canvasApi = viewer.get('canvas');
    fitCanvas();
    setTimeout(fitCanvas, 80);
    var registry = viewer.get('elementRegistry');
    function mark(id, cls) {
      if (id && registry.get(id)) canvasApi.addMarker(id, cls);
    }
    (completed || []).forEach(function (id) { mark(id, 'highlight-completed'); });
    (flows || []).forEach(function (id) { mark(id, 'highlight-completed'); });
    if ((!flows || !flows.length) && completed && completed.length) {
      var path = {};
      completed.forEach(function (id) { path[id] = true; });
      (activities || []).forEach(function (id) { path[id] = true; });
      registry.forEach(function (el) {
        if (el.type !== 'bpmn:SequenceFlow') return;
        var src = el.source && el.source.id;
        var tgt = el.target && el.target.id;
        if (src && tgt && path[src] && path[tgt]) mark(el.id, 'highlight-completed');
      });
    }
    (activities || []).forEach(function (id) { mark(id, 'highlight'); });
  }).catch(function (err) { console.error(err); });
})();
</script>
